mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ones who want to self actualize themselves, they want to achieve something they can be proud of for the sake of independence and autonomy."
Self-actualizer entrepreneurs are the ones who want to self actualize themselves, they want to achieve something they can be proud of for the sake of independence and autonomy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ones who are unhappy with the organization they worked with and decide to start a new venture for themselves."
Discontented entrepreneurs are the ones who are unhappy with the organization they worked with and decide to start a new venture for themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with his technical work of invention whereas an entrepreneur converts the technical work into economic performance."
An inventor is concerned with his technical work of invention whereas an entrepreneur converts the technical work into economic performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with how people tend to be self-employed and become successful because of their "troubled childhood"."
The model is concerned with how people tend to be self-employed and become successful because of their "troubled childhood".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a highly calculative individual who is always willing to undertake risks in order to achieve their goals."
An action oriented entrepreneur is a highly calculative individual who is always willing to undertake risks in order to achieve their goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ones who have the experience of owning at least two or more different firms, one at a time."
Habitual Entrepreneurs are the ones who have the experience of owning at least two or more different firms, one at a time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the person who bears risk, unites various factors of production; to exploit the perceived opportunities in order to evoke demand, create wealth and employment."
An entrepreneur is the person who bears risk, unites various factors of production; to exploit the perceived opportunities in order to evoke demand, create wealth and employment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the individuals who do not have any business ownership experience in the past (neither as a founder nor as inheritor) but now they own an independent business."
Novice entrepreneurs are the individuals who do not have any business ownership experience in the past (neither as a founder nor as inheritor) but now they own an independent business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred as individuals who are less included or integrated in their society."
Marginal men are referred as individuals who are less included or integrated in their society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of innovation and also the inducement to innovation and only the capitalist system allows the successful entrepreneur to take profit."
The profit for Schumpeter is the result of innovation and also the inducement to innovation and only the capitalist system allows the successful entrepreneur to take profit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ones who inherit their family business and expand it further."
Family business entrepreneurs are the ones who inherit their family business and expand it further.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the main advocates of this theory."
Harris are the main advocates of this theory.
